message.content: In the conversation regarding the karaoke night, ChaeSong-hwa expresses enthusiasm and excitement for the upcoming event. He also proposes including recent favorites along with popular pop songs such as "Shallow" or "Shake It Off," aiming to create a diverse and enjoyable night. ChaeSong-hwa concludes by expressing his anticipation for the karaoke night and encouraging everyone to finalize the date and give it a vibrant vibe.
